archive_index_truncation_policy: Reaching the limit is incomplete; never infer complete coverage from a capped index.
archive_policy: No newly discovered raw file fetched until its URL/series/capture is bound in a committed manifest. First-seen snapshot time is availability evidence, never backdate to report date.
availability_rule: Only after schema, vintage periods and publication-date evidence are validated. Use upper bound end of release date in America/New_York and wait one additional complete canonical XAU D1 interval; never backfill a first-created series into earlier decisions.
operator_request: Fullstendig B og nytt mål: implementasjon, build/trening og til slutt VAL/TEST/backtest over alle gyldige år.
purpose: Bounded archive recovery after almost three hours without archive calls; existing successful ALFRED archives reused. Stop remaining requests on first HTTP429. Index and availability metadata only.
transport_role: Mac HTTP relay only; byte-identical canonical probe and owner; no research computation or code edits on relay
